methods.label: Count the decreases and include the starting number
methods.explanation:
Counting backward from \(201\) to \(53\) requires \(201-53=148\) decreases by \(1\). The starting number \(201\) already occupies position \(1\), so the position of \(53\) is
\[
n=148+1=\boxed{149}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{D}\).
methods.levelReason: This is inclusive counting: the number of counted entries is one more than the number of unit gaps.
